instruction: Add 'Lecture 1' as a speaker note to the first slide of the lecture presentation on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to insert speaker notes from notes.docx into presentation slides. Opened VLC by mistake, then navigated slides in Impress, opened View menu to access Notes view, browsed through slides, but failed to complete note insertion across 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress slides, open View menu, click on text elements, browse slide panel, attempt to access Notes view
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed at the complex multi-app workflow: reading notes.docx content and pasting into Impress notes sections. Spent too many turns navigating without successfully inserting any notes. Opened VLC media player by mistake early on.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to single-slide note addition with explicit text, removing the need to read from a separate document
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding 'Lecture 1' as speaker note to slide 1. Getter reads notes text from slide index 0 of the pptx. Metric checks case-insensitive containment of expected text.
